RagShortTexts: Volga Bulgar craftsmen make precious metal ornaments.
Materials, skill and patrons’ means shape production.

Variants.Content: Volga Bulgar metalwork depends on traded materials, skilled hands and paying buyers. Fine work and joining take time; ornaments can be repaired or remade. Price includes craftsmanship, waste and delivery as well as weight.
Ornaments require identified ownership during escort. Fine damage may be repairable; crushing an object into metal destroys the labor embodied in it.
An ornament displays standing, but materials and finished work need separate accounting. Haste or nonpayment damages credit and future gift schedules.
Fine wire and joins require steady work; lost material consumes earnings. Repairing old ornaments also serves buyers unable to provide new precious metal.
